purpose: Update Residual Candidate Ledger 001 only where evidence materially changed a surviving route. Do not resume unbounded mechanism accumulation and do not treat technology novelty as opportunity evidence.

candidate_deltas.decision: Keep waiting for a qualified employer response or explicit rejection/no-residual signal. No third employer probe merely to raise sample count.

candidate_deltas.delta: Targeted public research continued to find mature feedback and service routes but did not produce a named smaller-exporter loss event caused by one granular target-market fact after those routes were considered.

candidate_deltas.delta: A named Xuzhou resource now satisfies the resource-first side strongly enough to become a concrete watch object.

concrete_resource.actor: 徐州国基原子制造有限公司
resource_truth: Jiangsu public reporting states the company has successfully produced special-metal atomic-cluster powders and its R&D engineer explicitly said the material is new and how to apply it is still an open question; the company is seeking downstream application partners.
Xuzhou/Nanjing University reporting says the company can stably produce metal-cluster powders below 10 nm and reach about 5 nm.
Nanjing University reports hundred-gram-scale W and Ni cluster-powder preparation and a W-Ni-Fe powder-metallurgy sheet with tensile strength improved by nearly 20%.
Nanjing University also reports that atomic-scale Ni powder can reduce a representative engine-casing repair process from about 1200 C to below 1000 C.
concrete_resource.partial_flow: Measured-property and laboratory/application evidence exists, but a repeatable industrial application portfolio is not yet publicly established by the company.
candidate_cost_side: Xuzhou XCMG Mining Machinery publicly reports core-part fatigue/short service life/high replacement cost and a strength-versus-lightweighting conflict.

This is only an adjacent paid pain. The same event already connected XCMG with an expert team using other fatigue/material/simulation routes, so it does not prove atomic-cluster powder is the missing edge.
concrete_resource.lowest_cost_next_truth: Find one named industrial task where current repair/sintering/joining temperature, residual stress, fatigue loss or material strength creates measurable cost, and define a coupon/sample acceptance test that compares the cluster powder against the incumbent material under the same task.
promotion_gate: Property-to-task compatibility stated in buyer decision coordinates
Evidence that existing powders/processes do not already solve the task acceptably
kill_conditions: The measured advantage disappears at relevant industrial process conditions
Required qualification/validation cycle makes the route unsuitable for low-cost reality testing
Existing mature powders/processes solve the buyer task at lower total cost
The company already has adequate downstream application routes and the apparent application gap is only ordinary sales expansion

comparators_rejected_or_downgraded.reason: Already has a defined use case and completed a 2026 patent transfer; not a resource awaiting discovery of its application.

candidate_deltas.decision: RCL-003 remains non-P0. The concrete resource improves observability of the route but does not justify field contact until buyer-side cost is narrowed to one task.

candidate_deltas.delta: Public examples continue to show that acceptance or inspection can be followed by later operating defects, but this does not prove a missing supplier-verification market after mature qualification systems.
candidate_deltas.decision: Do not promote until one named buyer shows measurable avoidable loss after ordinary supplier qualification, sample/trial, audit and acceptance.

research_rule_refined: RESOURCE_FIRST_APPLICATION_DISCOVERY requires a resource that demonstrably exists before its valuable application is settled; a mature product looking for more customers is not enough.
Novelty, laboratory performance and government promotion do not establish a downstream connection.
Do not pair a resource with a nearby industrial pain merely because technical vocabulary overlaps.
A concrete RCL-003 route needs measured property -> named paid pain -> bounded sample test -> buyer acceptance metric.
When public research can still identify the buyer-side last uncertainty, preserve human validation capital.
